slides.title: LibraCore: Cloud Library Management System
slides.subtitle:
Full-Stack SaaS Architecture, AWS DevOps & CI/CD Pipeline
VIT ISWE406L Lab Project

slides.title: Project Overview & Key Features
bullets: Modern SaaS Library Management System built for high concurrency and reliability
Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.2.3, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, PostgreSQL 15
Frontend: Responsive SPA with HTML5, CSS3, Chart.js analytics dashboard
Core Modules: Book Catalog Management, Member Directory, Borrowing & Returns, Automated Fines
API & Docs: RESTful endpoints with built-in OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger UI (/swagger-ui.html)

slides.title: System Architecture
bullets: Three-Tier Web Architecture:
- Presentation Layer: Single Page Application (HTML/JS/Chart.js) hosted on EC2
- Business Logic Layer: Spring Boot REST Controllers, Service beans, Validation & JPA Repositories
- Persistence Layer: AWS RDS PostgreSQL 15 (Managed DB instance with 20GB gp2 storage)
Cloud Integrations:
- AWS S3: Secure cloud storage for high-resolution book cover images
- AWS SNS: Automated library notifications and event dispatching

slides.title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment
bullets: Infrastructure Region: AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1)
Compute: Amazon EC2 t3.micro instance (Production-AppServer, running Spring Boot on port 8085)
Database: Amazon RDS PostgreSQL (db.t3.micro, private subnet with secure security group rules)
Infrastructure as Code: AWS CloudFormation stack (LibraryManagementSystemStack)
Monitoring & Security: CloudWatch application logs, CloudTrail audit trails, least-privilege IAM roles

slides.title: Automated DevOps CI/CD Pipeline
bullets: Version Control: GitHub Repository (Cloud-Based-Library-Management-System)
CI Runner: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on push/PR to main branch
Pipeline Stages:
1. Build & Test: Maven clean test (executing 34/34 passing unit & integration test suites)
2. Artifact Packaging: Generates library-management-system-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar
3. S3 Upload & Deployment: Pushes JAR to S3 bucket and triggers EC2 service restart via AWS SSM
4. Containerization: Builds and pushes Docker images to Amazon ECR

slides.title: Live Telemetry & Management
bullets: Live Web Dashboard: http://13.207.41.45:8085
API Documentation: http://13.207.41.45:8085/swagger-ui.html
Python Automation Scripts in Repo:
- start_aws_cloud.py / stop_aws_cloud.py: Infrastructure lifecycle control
- check_status.py / deploy_app.py: Remote health check and zero-downtime deployment
- seed_live_aws.py: Populates catalog with 22 real books and cover images
